# Why education, research & knowledge keeps re-telling the story of AhuraMazdā
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **AhuraMazdā** shows up constantly.

The mythology of AhuraMazdā is not a cycle of adventures but a grand cosmology: the creation of the world, the fall of the first man Yima, the choice offered to Zarathustra, and the final renovation (Frashokereti) when evil will be destroyed and the world made perfect. Every human moral choice participates in this cosmic drama.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** AhuraMazdā
- **Pantheon:** Zoroastrian
- **Domain of influence:** Supreme Creator, Wisdom, Light
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** Education, Research & Knowledge
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 8 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Call of Zarathustra.** In the Gāthās, AhuraMazdā approaches Zarathustra and asks him to choose between the two primordial spirits: Spenta Mainyu, the holy creative spirit, and Angra Mainyu, the destructive spirit of the lie.  Zarathustra chooses good thought, good words, and good deeds, becoming the prophet of the one wise lord. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Seven Creations and the Assault of Ahriman.** In later Zoroastrian texts, AhuraMazdā creates the world in seven stages: sky, water, earth, plants, animals, humans, and fire.  Angra Mainyu (Ahriman) responds by introducing drought, predators, disease, and death. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Education, Research & Knowledge

*Schools, universities, and research institutions. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The Wise Lord of living Zoroastrian devotion; the supreme creator of a world faith.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The Wise Lord at the center of living Zoroastrian devotion.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function AhuraMazdā performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Wisdom and Light are his canonical domain; the sun and the sacred radiance are the visible signs of the Wise Lord.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Thermal, Geothermal & Fire Energy

*Geothermal plants, combustion, and industrial heat. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The sacred fire is his visible presence, kept burning in fire temples for millennia; the eternal flame is his.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function AhuraMazdā performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: The mythology of AhuraMazdā is not a cycle of adventures but a grand cosmology: the creation of the world, the fall of the first man Yima, the choice offered to Zarathustra, and the final renovation (Frashokereti) when evil will be destroyed and the world made perfect. The age changed. The work did not.
